problem:
Consider the following vectors:

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 7\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- ${a}_{1}+2{a}_{2}+3{a}_{3}=0.$
- ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=0$ only if ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$
- The set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}$ is linearly independent.

feedback.problem:
Consider the following vectors:

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 7 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -5 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- $-{a}_{1}+2{a}_{2}+5{a}_{3}=0.$
- ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=0$ only if ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$
- The set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}$ is linearly dependent.
feedback.worked_solution:
We say that three vectors ${v}_{1},{v}_{2}$ and ${v}_{3}$ are *linearly independent* if the only solution to the equation

$$
{x}_{1}{v}_{1}+{x}_{2}{v}_{2}+{x}_{3}{v}_{3}=0
$$

is ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$ Otherwise, the vectors are *linearly dependent*.

With that in mind, let's look at each statement in turn.

- Statement I is false. Indeed:

$$
\begin{aligned}-{a}_{1}+2{a}_{2}+5{a}_{3} & =-[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 7 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+2[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -5 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+5[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =-[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 7 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -10 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}15 \\ 20 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2+0+15 \\ -7-10+20 \\ 0+0+5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}13 \\ 3 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne 0\end{aligned}
$$

- Statement II is true. The equation ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=0$ corresponds to the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{3}=0 \\ 7{x}_{1}-5{x}_{2}+4{x}_{3}=0 \\ {x}_{3}=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we can reorder the equations in this system as follows:

$$
{\begin{aligned}7{x}_{1}-5{x}_{2}+4{x}_{3}=0 \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{3}=0 \\ {x}_{3}=0\end{aligned}
$$

Solving this system using back substitution, we find that the solution is ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$

- Statement III is false. Since statement II is true, the set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}$ is linearly independent.

Therefore, the correct answer is "II only."
